spans.label: `HashChainError`: the six variants of the hash-chain family
spans.note: Only the variant set and its distinctness are modelled; the `thiserror` display strings are not. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: The crate-wide `UtilsResult` alias re-exported as this module's `Result`
spans.note: Error conversion into `UtilsError` is outside the model.

boundaries.name: plonky2-proof-soundness
boundaries.obligation: No proof object exists in this model. `verify_proof`, `conditionally_verify_cyclic_proof_or_dummy`, `add_verifier_data_public_inputs` and `cyclic_base_proof` are premises: the cyclic wrapper is modelled by its accept relation on public inputs, and a satisfied relation is NOT evidence that a proof exists or is sound.

boundaries.name: error-conversion
boundaries.obligation: `HashChainError` values are converted into the crate-wide `UtilsError` at every call site (`.map_err(...)`). The model keeps the six variants but does not track that conversion, so an error's identity at the caller is not proved.
